overview_description.description:
Verak offers better business insurance* for MSMEs and SMEs in India. Our goal is to be the preferred business insurance brand for 1M+ MSMEs by 2027. 

Our platform allows business owners to:

- Generate a commercial insurance quotation within minutes
- Get expert guidance on selecting the policy best suited to their business
- Have one-click support for endorsements, claims, and everything in between

Chat with us: https://bit.ly/VerakWA

*All insurance policies are offered through Insure First Insurance Brokers (License no.673)
